issues.display_title: Issue #156: feat(floorplan): persist eventRecords with the project snapshot
issues.main_description_html:
FE counterpart: GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap#764 · FE PRD: GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap#740

Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Event Highlights ride the existing project snapshot rather than a new endpoint — that was the FE design's explicit "out of scope: no new backend API". But POST /v1/floorplan whitelists jsonData field by field, and eventRecords has no case. The write returns 200 and the field is silently discarded, so every Event survives only in the browser's localStorage, and preview, GET /v1/floorplan/:id and GET /v1/live/:key never serve one.

Scope

  • models.Project.EventRecords — projects.event_records TEXT, alongside information_records (AutoMigrate + a migration for the Postgres runner).
  • src/action/v1/floorplan/post.go — accept eventRecords, same shape as the informationRecords case.
  • src/action/v1/floorplan/shared.go — buildFloorplanResponse returns eventRecords, so Get and Live serve it.
  • src/action/v1/project/duplicate.go — swap("event_records", &dup.EventRecords). Event photos are project-scoped /api/files?projectId=<id>&name=… URLs exactly like Information photos, so without it a duplicated project's event photos point at the source project.

Check

TestPostPersistsEventRecordsAndGetReturnsThem in src/action/v1/floorplan/post_event_records_test.go — POSTs an event, asserts the column holds it verbatim, then asserts the GET response carries it back. Proven to fail (400 jsonData has no supported project fields) with the whitelist case removed.

Deploy order

Ship this before or with the FE branch, and make sure the migration runs. Without the column the FE saves cleanly and loses every Event.

Status

Branch feature/740-event-records. go build ./... and go test ./... green. Not pushed yet.

RESULT

PR #157 → development. Branch feature/740-event-records, commit 7674bf2. 6 files.

projects.event_records TEXT (AutoMigrate + migrations/202608200001_add_event_records_to_projects.sql), the eventRecords case in the post.go whitelist, eventRecords in buildFloorplanResponse so Get and Live serve it, and swap("event_records", …) in duplicate.go so a duplicated project's event photos stop pointing at the source.

Verification: go build ./... and go test ./... green. TestPostPersistsEventRecordsAndGetReturnsThem round-trips an event through the handler and the response; with the whitelist case removed it fails at the POST with 400 jsonData has no supported project fields.

Deploy order: before or with GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap#766, migration run. Without the column the frontend saves cleanly and loses every Event.
